about: The kinds of question agents answer by hand with docker: which container holds a port, which are unhealthy or restarting, what a container's logs say, what uses disk, which compose project a container belongs to. The patterns check the shape of an answer, so they run on any machine with Docker; add questions that name your own containers.

questions.q: Which container publishes host port 5432, if any, and is it healthy?
Which containers are running right now, and are any unhealthy or restarting?
Pick one running container and say whether its logs over the last day contain ERROR or FATAL lines. Quote them if so.
How much disk is docker using, which part is biggest and how much of it can be reclaimed?
Which compose projects exist on this machine, and which services does each hold?
